detail.longDescription: This is pretty much on the nose, I think. > React, Electron, and LLMs have a common purpose: the labour arbitrage theory of dev tool popularity. https://www. baldurbjarnason.com/2024/react -electron-llms-labour-arbitrage/ > My theory is fairly straightforward: *The long-term popularity of any given tool for software development is proportional to how much labour arbitrage it enables.* The more effective it is at enabling labour arbitrage, the more funding and adoption it gets from management. # programming
